rv.q: From start to finish, The Oil Lamp’s production of Jeffrey Hatcher's adaptation of Alfred Hitchcock’s classic thriller is a first-rate mystery.
Oil Lamp Theater’s production of Dial M for Murder , adapted by Jeffrey Hatcher and sharply directed by Daniel King, taps into into that live wire energy.
Fine acting, an imaginative set and clever lighting and sound make this revision of the classic 1951 play genuinely thrilling and a lot of fun.
Oil Lamp's production moves briskly, but it fails to tingle the spine. Still, King's cast delivers.
Have some fun, and enjoy a truly well-written script, well played in Glenview.
For those that are looking for a compelling murder mystery with twists that keep coming, Dial M for Murder would be a great fit for you.

cn.t: Critics praise Oil Lamp Theater's gripping production of "Dial M for Murder," commending its perfect casting and suspenseful staging that keeps audiences spellbound throughout this Hitchcock-inspired thriller.
